samplingRule: At each y and each of9 x positions, compute signed RGB decomposition between y and y+16, staying inside declared range. Aggregate resulting per-pixel contributions across width; never average P,T,w first because covariance would violate the identity. Retain all sampled rows, not just favorable points.
colorDecode: Color modes: linear=(byte/255)^2.2/1.12. Raw weight: byte/255. Use conservative byte +/-1 intervals for non-saturated samples, explicitly assuming at most one output-code combined rounding/dither error; this is an uncertainty model, not proved GPU float equivalence. DITHER is not disabled. Exclude saturated0/255 color samples from finite inversion and dominance conclusions; report them as censored.
reconstruction: Compute Cpred=(1-w)P+wT per eligible pixel, compare observed decoded C. Propagate P,T,w output-code intervals by corner evaluation; compare to observed C interval with1e-7 linear-albedo numerical tolerance. Quantization/dither uncertainty is not random and does not shrink by averaging. Report residual and fraction outside assumed intervals; unresolved mismatch prevents causal inference.
interpretation: Report signed contributions, absolute magnitudes, cancellations and uncertainty by transect. Name dominant term only when evidence exceeds bounds consistently. No map-wide repair, visual acceptance or temporal aliasing claim.
scope: Diagnostic response overlay only; product bytes unchanged.
executionPreference: User monitors lengthy Actions; provide exact run link and pause.
pixelEligibility: Require alpha255 in all four PNGs and equal raw-weight R/G/B channels at each sampled pixel. Report and exclude any failing pixel. Saturated color endpoints are censored; weight endpoints retain bounded[0,1] factor intervals. Do not infer dominance from censored or otherwise ineligible samples.
